content: Live synergy tracker updated monthly, one row per initiative mapping: financial baseline, target/planned value, accountable owner, realization status, timing trigger, proof source. Track three layers: planned savings, actions-in-flight, realized savings evidenced in actual data. Cost-to-achieve rule of thumb: budget 1.0-1.2x annual run-rate synergy value to achieve it. Synergies typically fully phase-in (reach recurring run-rate) by year 3 post-close; revenue synergies additionally need leading indicators (pipeline, conversion, churn) not just booked revenue, tracked weekly.
